text:
Alex H.: Heads-up — final changelog cutover is today at 16:00 PT. Quick check: who’s owning sample apps, quickstarts, and the SDK changelog entry? Any blockers we should triage now?

Maria D.: Docs owns release notes + quickstarts. I need the exact CLI snippets and any API surface changes by 13:00 PT so samples/docs can be prebaked. cc @Sam T.

Sam T.: SDK team lead here — I’ll own the SDK changelog entry. PRs are merged but there’s one flaky test in go-client blocking the packaging job. I’ll try to fix before 12:30 PT; otherwise will open a patch.

Julie K.: Sample apps: I can own node/python samples. Blocked by a dependency bump (requests 2.30) that fails our py CI images. Investigating whether pinning to 2.29 is acceptable short-term.

Priya R.: If any owner is OOO after cutoff, what’s the fallback process? We need a documented handoff so release-oncall doesn’t guess.

Alex H.: Fallback plan: tag the release branch, release-oncall will merge the changelog PRs and kick the release-bot. Release-bot publishes canary and notifies #eng-oncall. Please add an explicit "fallback owner" line in your PR descriptions.

Sam T.: Publishing command for reference: ```./scripts/publish-sdk.sh --channel canary --tag vX.Y.Z``` Also changelog format: ```SDK: Short summary (one line)
- bullet: breaking? no
- bullet: notes/links
```

Maria D.: For docs, also include a copy-pasteable quickstart block. Example snippet we need: ```pip install redwood-sdk==vX.Y.Z
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))```

Julie K.: I opened a draft PR to pin requests for sample apps to get green CI: https://github.com/redwood/sample-python/pull/88. If we accept pin, we should include a TODO to unpin after CI images are upgraded.

Priya R.: QA smoke checklist (short):
- run sample quickstart (node/python) locally
- run sdk unit smoke: ```make smoke-sdk```
- run docs build: ```make docs-build && make docs-serve```
If anyone wants, I can run the smoke pass at 14:30 PT.

Sam T.: I’ll push a fix for the go test by 12:15 PT. If it’s late, I’ll mark Sam T. (fallback) in the changelog PR and assign release-oncall.

Maria D.: Noted. If the CLI or API examples change, leave a comment with the exact diff. Saves back-and-forth.

Alex H.: Quick owners summary — add to top of PRs please:
- SDK changelog: Sam T. (fallback: eng-oncall)
- Docs + quickstarts: Maria D. (fallback: Priya R.)
- Sample apps: Julie K. (fallback: Maria D.)

Julie K.: :thumbsup: I’ll unbreak the dockerfile and leave the TODO to upgrade base image.

release-bot: Tag v0.9.7-canary created by @release-bot for branch release/cutover-1719876543

Priya R.: Thanks — I’ll run the smoke pass at 14:30 PT and report results here. If anyone has a hard blocker before then, ping me asap.

Alex H.: Perfect. If smoke is green we do changelog cut at 16:00 PT and publish canary. If anything blocks, fallback process kicks in. Thanks team.
